Dengue dataset of Sierra Leone

dengue_sierra_leone.Rmd
library(denguedatasets)

The objective of this document is to show and provide elements of the exploratory data analysis so that users can have a quick view of the structure, data types, column names, and number of rows.

EDA with function glimpse of dplyr package 

dplyr::glimpse(dengue_sierra_leone)
#> Rows: 120
#> Columns: 5
#> $ date             <date> 2015-01-31, 2015-02-28, 2015-03-31, 2015-04-30, 2015…
#> $ temperature_c    <dbl> 24.84839, 26.18607, 27.01161, 27.85500, 27.27452, 25.…
#> $ humidity_percent <dbl> 77.86839, 79.02250, 72.77516, 76.61367, 84.55323, 90.…
#> $ precipitation_mm <dbl> 0.00, 0.56, 0.14, 3.96, 481.98, 751.34, 691.98, 851.1…
#> $ dengue_cases     <dbl> 9, 5, 0, 6, 21, 38, 49, 48, 37, 34, 11, 0, 7, 0, 0, 0…
